WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    st.healtheval AS health_status,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    health_status,
    average_gb_per_minute,
    scan_count,
    average_gb_per_minute - AVG(average_gb_per_minute) OVER () AS amount_above_mean
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT site_code, health_status, average_gb_per_minute, scan_count, amount_above_mean
FROM scored
WHERE average_gb_per_minute > (SELECT AVG(average_gb_per_minute) FROM group_stats)
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
